Apr 27

Graphify: turn any codebase into a queryable knowledge graph

Open-source Python tool (36,000 ⭐, MIT) that converts folders of code, docs, papers, images, and video into a queryable NetworkX knowledge graph. Three-pass pipeline: local AST extraction for 25+ languages via tree-sitter, Whisper-based audio/video transcription, and Claude subagents for semantic relationship extraction. Produces an interactive HTML visualization, a queryable JSON graph, and an audit report — with a claimed 71.5× token reduction per query vs. reading raw files. Integrates as a persistent skill with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot.
